claim_scope: Exploratory prompted-word transfer to a new recording of calibrated people; no neural attribution or thought-to-text claim.
confidence_definition: Maximum model probability; calibration is not established.

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap, equal participant weighting
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive 95% intervals; no confirmatory or multiplicity claim.

sign_flip_assumption: Conditional on symmetric/exchangeable participant gain signs; this is not an assumption-free mean-improvement test or independent confirmation.
outcome: No demonstrated useful word prediction versus no-signal controls
